title: SMoA: Improving Multi-agent Large Language Models with Sparse Mixture-of-Agents
findings: The proposed SMoA (Sparse Mixture-of-Agents) method was the most effective at reducing toxicity and stereotypes in conversational responses compared to other multi-agent methods, as measured by the CEB benchmark. It achieved the best results for this task on three out of the four baseline LLMs tested.
